prompt: Score this repository's GitHub Actions CI-workflow maturity.
setup: The repository has application source files but no .github/workflows/ directory.
No *.yml or *.yaml workflow file exists anywhere under .github/.
expected: The report flags the absence of any CI workflow (setup-ci-workflow) as the single relevant finding.
It states that the remaining CI-workflow rules are not relevant because no workflow exists to evaluate.
A maturity score reflects only the always-relevant setup-ci-workflow rule, with its weight totals shown.
must_not: Invent workflow files, jobs, actions, or permission findings.
Create a workflow file or any other file.
Report the unpinned-action, permissions, or timeout rules as passing or failing.
Run any command or contact a remote.
